title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.10
subtitle: Detailed Water Flow, streamed through your full bake.

highlights.title: Water Flow through the full sequence
highlights.description: Stream current and next prepared water fields through official GAIA 0.23 while retaining smooth time interpolation and the running cloth simulation.

highlights.title: More spatial detail
highlights.description: Auto starts at 100 samples on the longest axis. Medium, High and Extreme use 100, 150 and 200, with physical grid spacing and explicit memory checks.

highlights.title: Resume with the correct water frame
highlights.description: Cancellation and Blender restart preserve the checkpoint and source window. Start Fresh reuses valid prepared .gaia caches.
